name: Norwegian Prune Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Pick over and wash prunes, then soak one hour in cold water, and boil until soft; remove stones, obtain meat from stones and add to prunes.
Add sugar, cinnamon, boiling water, and simmer ten minutes.
Dilute corn-starch with enough cold water to pour easily, add to prune mixture, and cook five minutes.
Remove cinnamon, mould, then chill, and serve with cream.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pick over and wash prunes, then soak one hour in cold water, and boil until soft; remove stones, obtain meat from stones and add to prunes.
2. Add sugar, cinnamon, boiling water, and simmer ten minutes.
3. Dilute corn-starch with enough cold water to pour easily, add to prune mixture, and cook five minutes.
4. Remove cinnamon, mould, then chill, and serve with cream.
